name: mitsumeru
description: Mitsumeru — our own Electron shell around a DSH release. Epic 86 Track B.

scripts.package:dir: electron-vite build && bash scripts/prepare-harness.sh && bash scripts/check-identity.sh && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run package:mac:x64 && pnpm run package:mac:arm64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: electron-vite build && bash scripts/prepare-harness.sh --os darwin --cpu arm64 && bash scripts/check-identity.sh && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: electron-vite build && bash scripts/prepare-harness.sh --os darwin --cpu x64 && bash scripts/check-identity.sh && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:x64: electron-vite build && bash scripts/prepare-harness.sh --os win32 --cpu x64 && bash scripts/check-identity.sh && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.notarize:all: pnpm notarize:x64 && pnpm notarize:arm64 && pnpm manifest:merge
scripts.check:label: bash scripts/check-version-label.sh
